label: Bible Study
prompt: Thou shalt not follow a _____ to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
verse: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
note: Ancient Israel's law against peer pressure — the crowd doesn't get to decide what's right.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively _____ by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verse: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
note: Peter blesses God for a 'lively hope' — a living one, born out of an empty tomb.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and _____ which she did.
verse: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
note: Dorcas was known for good works and almsdeeds — including the coats and garments the widows showed Peter.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is _____.
verse: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
note: After contrasting the veil over Moses' face, Paul lands here: where the Spirit is, the veil comes off.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the _____, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:
verse: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:
note: God reminded King David where he started: 'I took thee from the sheepcote' — from following sheep to ruling Israel.
